description: Since fz-sc8.49, a type-test helper such as is_integer/1 is folded into the row as a type question. Its own executable is still reified, even when every use of it is folded. Expected: the helper is built only when something calls it at runtime; a job trace of a program that only uses folded type tests shows no reify job for the helper.
title: A guard helper that is only ever folded builds no plan of its own
